description: Hand-labelled reference evaluation example for Second Opinion

expected_findings.claim: Acme Corp provides employees with a $500 home office equipment reimbursement.
expected_findings.rationale: Directly supported by Section 1 statement of $500 reimbursement.

expected_findings.claim: Employees can purchase their own laptops and request reimbursement.
expected_findings.rationale: Directly contradicted by Section 1: 'Laptops are provided directly by IT and cannot be purchased for reimbursement.'

expected_findings.claim: In addition, workers receive a $100 monthly internet stipend.
expected_findings.rationale: The source policy makes no mention of internet stipends.
